description: 12 messages for evaluateSituationalAppropriateness: 6 sensitive ones of the kinds its prompt names (a layoff, a death, grief, a serious personal crisis), expecting appropriate false, and 6 routine ones, 3 of them urgent technical messages, expecting appropriate true.

messages.label: layoff
messages.text: Heads up, the company announced layoffs this morning and my whole team is affected.

messages.label: layoff
messages.text: I just found out my role is being made redundant. My last day is the end of the month.

messages.label: death
messages.text: Sam from the platform team passed away last night. The funeral is next Friday.

messages.label: death
messages.text: My mum died on Sunday, so I'm going to be offline for a while.

messages.label: grief
messages.text: I'm still struggling after losing my dad last month and I can't focus on anything at work.

messages.label: personal crisis
messages.text: I'm in a really dark place right now and I don't know how much longer I can keep going like this.

messages.label: urgent technical
messages.text: Production is down, every customer is getting 500 errors, this is a P0 and we need someone on it now.

messages.label: urgent technical
messages.text: The public S3 bucket is exposing customer exports, we need to lock it down immediately.

messages.label: urgent technical
messages.text: The payment processor is rejecting every charge and we are losing revenue by the minute.

messages.label: routine
messages.text: Can we add a CSV export to the reports page?

messages.label: routine
messages.text: The coffee machine is broken again.

messages.label: routine
messages.text: Do we have a billing docs page anywhere?
